chunks: And by this chain, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Ayoub ibn Nuh, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamza, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'The one who recites Al-Kahf during every night of Friday, it would be an expiation for what is between the Friday to the (next) Friday'.
He said, 'And it is reported by others as well regarding the one who recites it on the day of Friday after Al-Zohr and Al-Asr – similar (Rewards) to that'.

key_terms.الْكَهْفَ: Al-Kahf (The Cave), the 18th chapter of the Quran
key_terms.بَيْنَ الْجُمُعَةِ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ: Between the Friday and the Friday (i.e., the week)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for reciting Surah Al-Kahf on Friday?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this narration from Al-Kafi underscores the spiritual protection offered by reciting Surah Al-Kahf on Fridays, a practice linked to warding off the trials of the Dajjal as noted by scholars like Al-Majlisi. The hadith specifies that this expiation applies whether recited on Friday night or after the Zuhr and Asr prayers, emphasizing the day's sanctity. This practice is viewed as a means of maintaining spiritual purity and divine favor throughout the week.

en.hubeali: And by this chain, from Ali Bin Mahziyar, from Ayoub Bin Nuh, from Muhammad Bin Abu Hamza who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who recites (Surah) Al-Kahf (Chapter 18) during every night of Friday, it would be an expiation for what is between the Friday to the (next) Friday’.
He (the narrator) said, ‘And it is reported by others as well regarding the one who recites in on the day of Friday after Al-Zohr and Al-Asr (Salāt) – similar (Rewards) to that’.
en.sarwar: 7. It is narrated through the same chain of narrators as that of the previous Hadith from Ali ibn Mahziyar from Ayyub ibn Nuh from Muhammad ibn abu Hamzah who has said the following:
“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘If one recites chapter 18 of the Holy Quran every Friday night, it serves as an expiation for the matters from this to the next Friday.’”
The narrator of the Hadith has said that people other than him also have narrated about reciting this Chapter after the afternoon Salah (prayer) on Friday.”
